member.name: T:Roblox.Platform.Notifications.Core.EventTarget
member.summary: Represents the event target field on any notification field. Can either be a or a depending on the consumer of the notification subsystem.
member.remarks:
This class is essentially a wrapper around an event target in it's representation to provide a consolidated place where the transformations are taking place. It is furthermore overloading several operators for different reasons:
1. It is implementing the , and interface to provide backwards compatibility with code which is expecting to deal with long values which have a different equality behaviour as compared to classes. This class is implementing equality based on the content of the event target string. 2. To fulfill it's main purpose, it is overloading the implicit operator string and implicit operator long as well as the inverse ones which allow this class to be implictly cast from/to a string/long. This allows the consumers of the notification subsystem which are always using longs for the event target to use this class as a without having to replicate the same parsing logic in different places.
In addition, it also has a custom so it is seralized as a simple string instead of as an object.
